title: thinopyrum intermedium subsp. barbulatum
intro: Thinopyrum intermedium subsp. barbulatum, commonly known as Roegner's wheatgrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Roegner's wheatgrass include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and support immune function, making it a potential natural remedy for digestive issues and immune-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of Roegner's wheatgrass include chlorophyll, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
